Full Mathas Lemma 3.38 and Theorem 3.39, printed pp.33-34 (PDF pp.39-40), were read visually; the source additionally uses right-handed Proposition 3.16, absent from the local supplier contract. Owner must complete that construction in the assigned A page or disposition the retained unsupported implication.
